item.title: Sequin Types for Eveningwear
item.description:
Why sequin choice matters

For evening dresses sold on Fashion Nova, SHEIN, Temu, or Windsor Store-style storefronts, sequin selection is not only aesthetic—it drives returns, photo QC pass rates, and chargeback risk. The wrong sequin size or attachment method looks stunning in studio lighting and fails after one wear or one carton transit.

Flat sequins (3–5 mm)

Flat sequins remain the volume workhorse for bodycon minis and midi dresses. They lay close to the fabric, photograph evenly, and pack denser in cartons. Specify density maps on the tech pack: sparse fields look cheap; over-dense fields crack when stretched. Ask your factory for a stretch swatch before bulk.
